//: Stylised video via pluggable style packs. A pack is JSON under prompts/styles/ and touches three layers: prompt look (style middleware), camera habits (camera-check), and the pixels themselves (grade stage). Swapping schools is one pack id — no stage rewrite, no re-prompt.

shippedPacks.shaw-brothers-wuxia: 邵氏武侠 — soundstage colour, gel lighting, permanent amber dusk, held proscenium frames. Saturation pushed, warm highlights over cool shadows, vignette + grain.
shippedPacks.king-hu-wuxia: 胡金铨武侠 — real locations, bamboo and haze, ink-wash palette, Peking-opera choreography cut in 'glimpses'. Desaturated, contrast up, shorter shots.
shippedPacks.hk-neon-noir: 港式霓虹夜色 — neon as key light, rain-slick streets, crushed blacks. Included to prove the seam is genre-neutral.
shippedPacks.none: The explicit opt-out. No anchors, no grade — the grade stage stream-copies instead of re-encoding.

middleware.//: AFTER camera-grammar: the camera rewrite should see the story's own wording, and the style clause lands last where the model reads it as a frame-wide constraint.

pipeline.//: The pack's preferredMoves narrow the camera vocabulary; off-school moves are reported by name.
One re-encode for the whole cut, before music and subtitles. Records project.style so a delivery can say what look it carries.

authoringANewPack.//: Drop a JSON in prompts/styles/. Unknown fields are rejected, so a typo fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
authoringANewPack.label: 示例流派
authoringANewPack.source: where the look was studied from — packs make claims about real films

look.image: prepended to image prompts — the anchor the whole frame obeys
look.video: appended to video prompts — how this school moves
look.negatives: joined onto the shot's own negatives, never replacing them

pacing.note: how long this school holds a frame

offlineVerification.//: The video stub renders a flat colour per shot, which shows nothing about a grade. Set source=testsrc for a patterned frame and the grade becomes legible without paying a provider.
